kept.name: TestAppendOrFold_FoldThenDoneThenStuckAppendsFresh
kept.reason: pins that a fold ends at a done or awaiting entry and the next stuck appends fresh, which its covering test does not

kept.name: TestAppendOrFold_InputUnchanged
kept.reason: pins that appendOrFold never mutates or aliases its input, which its covering test does not

kept.name: TestEpisodeStuckCount_FoldedEqualsUnfolded
kept.reason: pins that a folded history counts the same stuck episode as the unfolded calls, which its covering tests do not

kept.name: TestEpisodeStuckCount_SegmentDoneEndsEpisode
kept.reason: pins that a segment Bouncer's done ends a Burler-round row's episode and segmentEnders of a standalone row is nil, which its covering tests do not

kept.name: TestGoto_MovesBlockedRunToTarget
kept.reason: pins that goto clears Error, Transient and PauseRequested and records the goto history entry and activity, which its covering tests do not

kept.name: TestHistoryEntry_FoldFieldsOmittedWhenZero
kept.reason: pins the repeats and last_at JSON omission and round-trip, which its covering test does not

kept.name: TestHistoryEntry_MissingBudgetExemptDecodesAndCounts
kept.reason: pins that an absent budget_exempt decodes as false, counts as a stuck and is omitted on marshal, which its covering test does not

kept.name: TestProgressAt_CyclicOnDone
kept.reason: pins that an OnDone cycle terminates the step count, which its covering tests do not
